title: Speaking — Improving a service
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on improving a service.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
What good service have you experienced recently?
Do you usually tell a business what it could improve?

part2.topic: Describe a service that was improved after people gave feedback.
part2.closing: and explain why you think the change helped.

questions: How can organisations hear from users who rarely make complaints?
When should organisations act on individual feedback and when should they wait for more evidence?
How has everyday life connected with improving a service changed for people of different ages?
